sources.title: English Models and Benchmarks | OpenVoiceOS/ovos-m2v-pipeline | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The ovos-m2v-pipeline provides a specialized family of English-only models based on the Potion architecture. These models are designed to provide a high-performance alternative to the default multilingual model for users operating exclusively in English. This page details the specific model variants, their performance metrics, and technical considerations for selection.

sources.title: Model2Vec - OVOS Technical Manual - openvoiceos.github.io
sources.snippet: Model2Vec Intent Pipeline The Model2Vec Intent Pipeline is an advanced plugin for OpenVoiceOS, designed to enhance intent classification using pretrained Model2Vec models. By leveraging vector-based representations of natural language, this pipeline offers improved accuracy over traditional deterministic engines, especially in scenarios where intent recognition is challenging.
